why: Both land on the key's hedgehog (convenient pharmacy-led drugstores, profit per customer visit) and the same brutal facts, but Analysis 2 explicitly treats the company as already great and frames its stop-doing list as temptations to refuse, covering all the key's points including no re-diversification. Analysis 1 is solid but more interventionist (dropping the 3,000-store target, re-basing the growth plan), never recognises greatness, and overclaims in places, such as saying nobody is measuring profit per visit.
